source.name: SA Rugby: Pick n Pay joins SA Rugby family of partners
source.quote: Pick n Pay has signed a four-year contract as a Tier 1 sponsor of SA Rugby, with the company’s logo set to feature in gold on the back of the Springbok jersey
source.note: Four-year contract announced 27 March 2025, so 'to' is expected around 2029; recorded as null until an end month is stated. Placement changed from 'partner' to 'back' (the gold Pick n Pay logo on the back of the matchday jersey).
